LESSON: KEEPING HOME

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Social Home a) name various things found in the  Learners to identify and name 
Topic 2.1.2: Keeping home

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Keeping home. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: what t makes the home  Learners to demonstrate cleaning of home dirty?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. participate actively in making the home environment clean
2. demonstrate willingness to keep the home environment clean.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. participate actively in making the home environment clean
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to participate actively in making the home environment clean. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. demonstrate willingness to keep the home environment clean.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate willingness to keep the home environment clean. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Keeping home.
2. Explain Keeping home to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Learners find out what makes the home 1. What makes our environment learner should be able to: environment dirty home environment clean a) identify what t makes the home
4. Show that you can: participate actively in making the home environment clean
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Keeping home. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: what t makes the home  Learners to demonstrate cleaning of home dirty?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
